identitySignals: Berkeley Farms was a Hayward, CA milk processor (Dean Foods subsidiary), matching the agenda's Hayward, CA location and the milk/dairy bid

The Hayward plant closed at the end of April 2020; the berkeleyfarms.com website is now copyrighted by a different company (Shehadey Family Foods, LLC), so it cannot be confirmed as the same entity as 'Berkeley Farms Dairy LLC'
research.notes: Original Berkeley Farms Dairy LLC (Hayward) appears defunct since 2020. The trademark was sold separately and berkeleyfarms.com is now operated under a different owner, so no website or contact details were published. No registry (CA SOS, SAM.gov) records were verified.

profile.summary: Berkeley Farms was a Bay Area dairy company that processed and distributed milk from a plant in Hayward, California. It was owned by Dean Foods from 1998. The Hayward facility closed in April 2020 after Dean Foods filed for bankruptcy.
